5|package router
6|
7|import (
8|	"fmt"
9|	"strings"
10|	"sync"
11|	"time"
12|)
13|
14|// ============================================================================
15|// Endpoint registry and fast lookup cache
16|// ============================================================================
17|
18|type RouteEntry struct {
19|	Path      string
20|	Method    string
21|	HandlerID string
22|	Weight    int
23|	CreatedAt time.Time
24|}
25|
26|type RouterRegistry struct {
27|	mu     sync.RWMutex
28|	routes map[string]RouteEntry
29|}
30|
31|func NewRouterRegistry() *RouterRegistry {
32|	return &RouterRegistry{
33|		routes: make(map[string]RouteEntry),
34|	}
35|}
36|
37|func (r *RouterRegistry) Register(method, path, handlerID string) error {
38|	r.mu.Lock()
39|	defer r.mu.Unlock()
40|	key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", strings.ToUpper(method), strings.ToLower(path))
41|	if _, exists := r.routes[key]; exists {
42|		return fmt.Errorf("route already registered: %s", key)
43|	}
44|	r.routes[key] = RouteEntry{
45|		Path:      path,
46|		Method:    method,
47|		HandlerID: handlerID,
48|		Weight:    1,
49|		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
50|	}
51|	return nil
52|}
53|
54|func (r *RouterRegistry) Lookup(method, path string) (RouteEntry, bool) {
55|	r.mu.RLock()
56|	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
57|	key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", strings.ToUpper(method), strings.ToLower(path))
58|	entry, ok := r.routes[key]
59|	return entry, ok
60|}
